<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni crisis]]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[Attacks on the Eternity C|Attacks on the ''Eternity C'']]
****The [[Houthis]] release eleven seamen from the ''Eternity C'' carrier. [https://www.reuters.com/world/houthis-release-crew-greek-operated-cargo-ship-struck-red-sea-2025-12-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/3/yemens-houthis-release-9-mariners-held-since-july-ship-attack (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
***[[2025 Hadhramaut offensive]]
****The [[Southern Transitional Council]] seizes swathes of territory from the [[government of Yemen]] in [[Hadhramaut Governorate]], including [[Seiyun]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/03/world/middleeast/yemen-militias-attack-oil-uae.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]] says it will reopen the [[Rafah border crossing]] with [[Egypt]], allowing [[Palestinians]] to leave the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpwk7xen544o (BBC News)] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/israel-receives-remains-of-possible-hostage-and-plans-to-reopen-gaza-crossing-into-egypt (PBS)]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***Five [[Palestinians]], including two children, are killed by Israeli drone strikes near [[Khan Younis]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/3/live-israeli-forces-kill-357-palestinians-in-50-days-of-ceasefire-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli army]] says four of its soldiers were wounded in a [[Hamas]] attack in [[Rafah]].  [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-khan-younis-airstrike-targeting-hamas-operative-after-attack-on-troops/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]]
**[[Malaysia]] announces that the search for the wreckage of [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]] will resume on December 30, with [[Ocean Infinity]] conducting a 55-day [[Underwater searches|underwater search]] in a targeted area of the southern [[Indian Ocean]] under its existing "[[Contingent fee|no-find, no-fee]]" agreement with [[Government of Malaysia|the government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/search-missing-flight-mh370-resume-december-30-malaysia-says-2025-12-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza peace plan]]
***The Israeli [[Knesset]] votes 39–0 to endorse the 20-point Gaza peace plan, in a vote boycotted by the member parties of the [[Thirty-seventh government of Israel|Netanyahu government]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/12/03/middleeast/knesset-vote-trumps-gaza-plan-intl (CNN)]
